name: Zercher Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Set up for the Zercher Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat with a barbell. Stand tall with your core braced.
Step into the lunge position and lower until both knees are bent, keeping your torso upright.
Drive through your front foot to return to the start, keeping your hips level.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: Zercher Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat is a intermediate lunge exercise for the quadriceps and glutes, performed with a barbell.
